title: Current proof first. Archived shipped systems second.
summary: Start with the current secure-data runtime slice, then use the archived case studies as supporting evidence for delivery under load, integration pressure, and operational constraints.

current_proof.title: Current flagship proof
current_proof.subtitle: The secure-data slice is the repo's strongest current proof surface: encrypted storage, persisted sensitive-access grants, background sync, and audited authorized-read decisions.

supporting_cases.title: Supporting proof archive
supporting_cases.subtitle: These older case studies stay reachable as archived support. They show delivery under operational load, live integrations, and automation constraints, but they are not the current flagship proof.

archive_details.title: Archived supporting-proof details
archive_details.subtitle: The legacy cases now live here as anchored archive entries. The dedicated current-proof route stays `/work/sensitive-sync`, and the live runtime proof stays on `/lab`.

open_source_teaser.title: Need the code-level proof too?
open_source_teaser.summary: The open-source page shows invariant-oriented Rust API design, namespace discipline, and tooling surfaces that complement the application proof.
